_about: ONE source for the mail clients, read by scripts/mail_deliver.py (the CLI) and, once the app is moved over, by app/design/phases/build.py. Nothing else may hold these values as literals: tests/test_mail_clients_single_source.py fails if it does. Only WHO the clients are, WHERE their web compose pages are and WHAT WORDS to share live here. How each surface delivers (files, links, copy buttons) stays in that surface.
